row:
Hey Guys! It's Ashlee and Chelsi. We are two Caribbean girls  who are passionate about food, travel and education.

We've both finished our undergraduate degrees and we are looking to better ourselves for other things in the future. 

We decided to create this channel and make videos about our experiences at college while showing the contrast between our two experiences.

Note: We are not professional editors so please bear with us

We hope you enjoy our videos!
